description: Items flagged for manual review. Each links to the official source where applicable; unverified values are left blank and never inferred.

items.item: Predicted totals use an unverified league-average baseline for 23 of 23 games

Per-player impact weights are transparent model estimates of rotation-minute/production impact, not verified importance values (which require player-level usage/box-score data).
